text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: (Alright, time to make my move!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: (—Huh? ...Wait, what?)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
(Something's wrong... Why isn't my speed 
picking up...?)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
(My legs feel so heavy... Why? Fatigue? No 
way, I'm not moving forward at all...!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
(The image, the feel of my running—it's 
all completely off!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: K-Kh... Aaaahhhh!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria crosses the finish line in 
first! She achieves an irregular Double 
Crown, the first since Rhein Kraft!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... hah...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, an irregular Double Crown! For 
real?! Gran Alegria really is incredible!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She's totally unrivaled in the mile! 
Though today didn't quite feel as dominant 
as the Oka Sho, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria stood dazed and motionless on 
the turf...
choice_data_list:
Gran's running... it felt a little off 
somehow...

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...So you felt it too. Her running was 
strangely disjointed, wasn't it?
choice_data_list: Alright, I'm off!
I'm heading out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I run toward her at full speed. —From 
beyond the underground horse path, I could 
see Gran Alegria walking over.
choice_data_list: Gran! Are you okay!?
Gran! You okay!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ah... Trainer-san...
choice_data_list:
You didn't hurt yourself anywhere, did 
you?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes, no injuries in particular... 
............But...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I... completely misread the situation. It 
seems I was actually exhausted, but I 
didn't even notice...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Normally, I'd be able to see how I should 
run. Today, I just... couldn't figure it 
out at all!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"But I told myself I had to go! I dug deep 
and pushed through! And then—"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I have a bad feeling about this...
choice_data_list: Gran...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I was so scared... I thought you were 
hurt...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: T-That was so scaaary...! Waaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Heart-wrenching sobs echo through the 
underground paddock tunnel. My chest aches 
at the sight of her trembling hand 
clinging to my sleeve.
choice_data_list:
(If only I'd noticed something was 
wrong...)

(If only I'd noticed something was 
wrong...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I never should have made you feel so 
helpless and alone...

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...So, you're not hurt or feeling any 
pain, right?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I'm okay. I'm sorry for making such 
a big fuss.
choice_data_list:
I'm the one who should be sorry for not 
noticing sooner.

No, I'm sorry I didn't notice how you were 
feeling.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
No...! It's just that I relied too much on 
my "gut feeling"!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I just assumed her good condition from the 
Oka Sho was carrying over, and misread 
things...
choice_data_list: I also judged that it would be fine.

I ended up convincing myself that I was 
fine too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her running was so genius-level that I 
assumed the accuracy of her "intuition" 
was flawless as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as I gradually got the "hang" of it... 
I began to foolishly think I understood 
everything.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A vague understanding isn't good enough. 
I have to understand Gran Alegria 
properly."
choice_data_list:
I'll strive to understand you better than 
anyone else

I'll strive to understand you even better 
than you understand yourself.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...If you can see what needs to be done, 
let's keep that in mind and think about 
what comes next.
choice_data_list: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—So, Gran. You don't have any reluctance 
toward running, do you?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list:
You went through something scary, so don't 
push yourself.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Um, truth be told... Pushing myself too 
hard kinda scares me...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Probably because I'm in a growth spurt, I 
feel like I haven't been able to properly 
optimize my senses."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Races at a mile or shorter are no problem 
for me. Medium distance, though... I just 
can't picture myself running it.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... If that is the case, dedicating the 
summer to physical conditioning is an 
option as well.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
――But... I still want to conquer all three 
divisions!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Selfish at 70 miles per hour, sorry!
choice_data_list: It's your future, so don't hold back.
It's your future, so don't hold back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Conquering three categories means winning 
at Sprint, Mile, and Medium distance. If 
we avoid Medium distance—

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for short distances might be good. 
Adjusting for them is close to miles, so 
it should be manageable.
choice_data_list: Then how about the 1,400m Hanshin Cup?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was also the sprint GⅠ, the 
Sprinters Stakes, but its timing right 
after summer gave me pause.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Considering the preparation period, we 
can't take our time. I'm worried about 
making her feel rushed.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so the primary target is next 
spring's Takamatsunomiya Kinen, and you 
want to test things out in a real race 
beforehand. How about it, Gran?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm completely fine!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Starting from the Hanshin Cup, we begin 
our campaign to conquer the sprint races!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had the doctor examine Gran Alegria, and 
since there were no issues, we left the 
racecourse.
Ah, Gran-chan!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness, I was worried you'd 
already gone home...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Craft-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I just really wanted to tell you 
today...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations on achieving the 
unconventional Double Crown. And... thank 
you."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Thank you? Um...?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, that makes no sense, right?! You 
see, I... was just so happy.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
The fact that Gran-chan chose the same 
path as me.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Because I realized... we can pass things 
down in this kind of way, too."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...It's purely my own selfish gratitude. 
Even so... I just had to tell you."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so! You're very welcome!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two girls smile happily. It was a 
smile that gently warmed the heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back, we stopped by a bookstore 
to look for reference materials. Gran 
Alegria came along with me.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, this magazine. It's Ai-senpai's...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I follow Gran Alegria's gaze. Almond Eye's 
name was printed on the magazine cover.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beside it was the headline: "Declares 
Skipping the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe." 
Just a short while ago, Almond Eye 
announced in a press conference that she 
would not run in the Arc.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
You said the reason she isn't running is 
because she lacks the aptitude for it, 
right?
choice_data_list:
The turf and track bed are totally 
different over there, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Overseas races differ greatly from Japan 
in both course characteristics and race 
development. One could say aptitude 
matters even more than in domestic races.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Even for Eye-senpai, who conquered the 
races in Dubai, the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe is tough, huh...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The wall of aptitude... Even I'm starting 
to understand just how high it really is.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Until I get a feel for running medium 
distances, I'll closely observe every 
single mile.
choice_data_list:
Let's move forward steadily, one step at a 
time!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
You're right! First, I'll do my best in 
the Hanshin Cup!
